remarks: MONTH TO MONTH DESK RENTAL in this fabulous 3,512 sq. ft. unique space in the heart of downtown SoNo. Your own glass-enclosed office with desk and wifi. Access to conference room, kitchen, color printer. It has three levels, two bathrooms, a kitchen, and views of the Long Island Sound. Loft-like space, high ceilings, very tall windows with great light. Elevator building with electronic office and building security. Bring your business to the hottest neighborhood in Fairfield County. Just steps to the South Norwalk Train Station, less than one hour to Grand Central. Easy access to I95, Route 7 and the Merritt Parkway. Can be divided or shared.
